children: In accordance with the Financial Conduct Authority’s Prospectus Regime Manual Rule 1.6.4R, Aviva plc (the Company) announces that between 1 September 2026 and 30 September 2026 it has issued and allotted 3,664 ordinary shares of 32 17/19 pence each (ISIN: GB00BPQY8M80) in connection with Company employee share schemes, as detailed below.
The shares were previously admitted to trading on the London Stock Exchange Main Market under a block admission to trading.
The shares rank equally and are fully fungible with the existing ordinary shares of the Company.
Number of further shares admitted to trading covered by the notification:
